threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still use the word 'Underground' instead of just 'Tube' and look confused when people mention the Overground connections.
Last night on the 59, two blokes argued about a broken seat. One swore that it ruined his whole evening, like that’s the real tragedy of Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I spotted a guy fixing his bike on the sidewalk while simultaneously grilling sausages. Only in Neukölln can you mix repairs with a BBQ.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a bar that serves cocktails in mason jars while a raccoon casually rummages through the trash outside.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who's local by how they navigate BART delays—if they mention the 'Civic Center chaos' like it's just another Wednesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 bus yesterday and saw a guy serenading the whole ride with a ukulele. Only in the Tenderloin do you get live music with your commute.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia’s all about the squares, but it’s the narrow streets that hold the best surprises—little bakeries and hidden murals.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still look bewildered by the tram system, clinging to their maps while locals zip past them, seamlessly navigating the chaos.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think opposing a cyclist is a sound argument instead of just letting them go by. Welcome to Dalston, mate!
Last night, the 59 was stuck in traffic by the Ritzy while a guy in a tracksuit performed a full dance routine in the aisle. No one really reacted.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was really home when I saw a spontaneous dance party break out at Hermannplatz, complete with a boombox and two sax players. Classic Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a bar that serves cocktails in old football trophies. It's a quirky nod to the local sports scene, and you'll leave with a story.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re from here when they can spot a tourist at the taco truck a block away and still manage to hustle through the crowd without breaking stride.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a Muni driver calmly negotiate a passenger's karaoke session at 8th and Market. Only in SF do you get a live concert on the way to work.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often miss how quiet Gràcia gets after 10 PM. The lively squares turn into ghost towns—it's where the real locals unwind.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by their confusion when they try to navigate the one-way streets and end up taking the longest route to the nearest metro.
